name: Red Fox
intro: A red fox is a wild animal with red fur. It has a big, fluffy tail.

sections.title: What does it look like?
sentences: A red fox has red fur on its back and tail.
Its throat and belly are white or gray.
It has big, pointy ears.
Its feet are black.
Its fluffy tail has a white tip.

sections.title: Where does it live?
sentences: Red foxes live in many parts of the world.
They live in woods and fields.
Some live in towns and backyards.
A fox family lives in a den.

sections.title: What does it eat?
sentences: Red foxes eat plants and animals.
They like to eat mice and rabbits.
They also eat birds, bugs, and berries.
They can hear mice digging under the ground.

sections.title: How does it grow?
sentences: A baby fox is called a kit.
Kits are born in the spring.
At first, their eyes are closed.
Both parents bring food to the kits.
Kits stay with their parents for about seven months.

sections.title: Fun facts
sentences: A red fox can make more than 20 different calls.
A group of foxes is called a skulk.
Red foxes can see well at night.
Foxes look like dogs but act a bit like cats.
A mother fox is called a vixen.

vocab.meaning: A safe hole where an animal lives.
An animal that eats both plants and meat.
